title: Blackhold_HD
description: A simple mod add a new draw called Blackhold_HD.
body:
**A simple mod add a new draw called Blackhold_HD.**

When your base doesn’t feel epic enough — this painting fixes that instantly. Front and center stands the **blackhold_hd**, rocking those blue pixel eyes like a main-character aura, backed dramatically by the flag as if about to deliver the “Village Independence Declaration.” Hang it on your wall and your room immediately enters Ultimate Entrance Mode: villagers pause in silence, friends gain instant respect, and even creepers might reconsider exploding (no promises). This isn’t just decoration — it’s a spiritual totem, an epic pixel cover art, the officially certified spokesperson of your base. XD.

![Blackhold_HD](https://files.seeusercontent.com/2026/02/20/7Smm/84f7866.png)

**For the detailed information, please read the minute contents below. THANKS!!!**
